title: Left/right arrows navigate by day, week, or month depending on the active range, and the date label shows the current range
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Schedule page.
custom_steps:
1. In week view, click the right arrow and read the date label.
2. Switch to day view and click the right arrow.
3. Switch to month view and click the left arrow.
custom_expected:
1. Week view: each arrow click moves one whole week; the label shows the week range (spec's example format: 'Jul 14 to 20, 2026').
2. Day view: each click moves one day; the label shows that day.
3. Month view: each click moves one month; the label shows that month.
4. The label always matches what the grid displays.
